xmldoc.short_description: Position of a graphics object in pixels.

param_input_item.param_description: a scalar graphics object, or the number of a figure.
a logical scalar: false (default) for a position relative to the parent, true for a position relative to the figure.

param_output_item.param_description: a 1x4 double vector [left bottom width height] in pixels.

description.p: position = getpixelposition(h) returns the Position of h converted to pixels, whatever its Units. The position is relative to the parent of h, and the first pixel of the parent is 1. The object is not modified.

position = getpixelposition(h, true) returns the position relative to the figure that holds h: for every container between h and the figure, its left and bottom values (counted from 1) and the thickness of its border and title are added.
For a figure, the position is relative to the screen.
An object that has no four element Position expressed in Units (a line, a text, the root) and an empty input return [0 0 0 0].
The 'characters' unit is a cell of 7 by 15 points (28/3 by 20 pixels), whatever the font of the object.
